status: FROZEN_BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION; DEV_TRAIN_ONLY; NO OFFICIAL HELDOUT OR SCIENCE ACCEPTANCE

source.kind: historical noncanonical Wikidata-derived archive, not contemporary facts or the canonical Wikidata5M evaluation

mask.recipe: WSP103 (s,p)-group SHA256 mask: low five digest bits 0, lowest 4096 SHA priority across source, retain all nonmasked facts

hypothesis: With the same bounded relation-frequency candidate universe, subject-specific retained-only two-hop paths may change candidate ranks in predicting truly masked training graph relation values. No accuracy gain is guaranteed.

frequency.source: WSP104 retain-only Misra-Gries 64 candidate per relation; exact retained frequency recount; precommitted baseline Hits@1=921/4096, Hits@10=1853/4096, reverse Hits@1=2/4096, Hits@10=44/4096

controls.path_only: From retained outgoing neighbors of each masked-query subject, count all retained two-hop paths s--r1-->z--r2-->o with arbitrary r1,r2 but only within the WSP104 same 64 candidates of queried predicate; abstain when no positive paths.
controls.path_first: Rank the same WSP104 64 candidates by descending two-hop path votes, break ties using exact retained predicate-frequency ranking and ascending object ID. When no supported paths fallback to WSP104 order.
controls.reverse: Same candidate list, reverse WSP104 frequency ordering; reproduces its frozen receipt.
controls.lookup: Retained exact (s,p) masked query lookup must be zero by complete-group separation.

neighbors.eligible: outgoing retained records only, including any predicate r1; entire masked group excluded
neighbors.sort: smallest SHA256(UTF8('WSP105-NEIGHBOR-v1\\0') || little_endian uint32 subject, predicate r1, object z) first 64-bit unsigned big-endian; tiebreak predicate then object IDs ascending
neighbors.dedup: unique (r1,z) per query subject; dedup (z,query_key) when joining

metrics: macro Hits@1 Hits@10 best-answer MRR frequency/path-only/path-first/reversed
number of queries with any supported two-hop path
difference path-first vs frequency from same source
negative_controls: synthetic no paths => path-only abstains and path-first exactly falls back to frequency
synthetic context path directs correct answer other than popularity
masked query group never a trained edge

budget.network: allowlisted pinned HTTPS archive read only, no paid APIs

decision: If path ranking improves, it is DEV association signal only; if null/regressive, preserve as negative without changing neighbors, scoring, split or thresholds. This does not substitute for a fully trained conventional KGE baseline or independent symbolic path-rule learner, let alone demonstrate direct weight superiority.
